name: ImageMagick
role: Baseline CLI for image ops, montage, compare and inspection; the validated stills toolchain
summary: The command-line image toolbox (magick, identify, compare, montage, mogrify). Handles convert, resize, composite, draw, annotate, alpha statistics, diffs and contact sheets across nearly every format. In VCR it is the validated baseline for stills work: drawing synthetic frames, measuring alpha, and comparing output. Strength is breadth and ubiquity, not speed or colour management.
use_when: Default for any still-image convert, resize, composite, draw or annotate
Comparing frames or reading alpha stats and metadata as test evidence
Contact sheets and montages of a frame sequence for review
Over Sharp when a shell script is simpler than a Node process
avoid_when: Large batches where speed and memory matter: libvips or Sharp
ACES or OCIO colour-managed conversion: oiiotool
Strict security with untrusted files: restrict policy.xml or use libvips
notes: 2026-10-26: official_url ends in a trailing slash and the fetch returned a redirect to /command-line-tools/; consider dropping the slash. Homebrew formula is at 7.1.2-34 while validation evidence was taken on 7.1.2-15.

assessment.rationale: Release 7.1.2-34 on 2026-10-14 per the project's release feed. Validated in this repo as the stills baseline; no neighbour replaces its breadth.

evidence.result: 48 synthetic frames drawn; alpha statistics and identify used by browser-capture and blender-smoke
